scope: Calculated approximate optical visualization of a plausible rotation-powered pulsar; not a Vela observational reconstruction
physical_model: Prescribed near-zone dipole, pair activation and physical harmonic radiation; optical emission is separate from the reduced PIC dynamics
exposure_definition: Half the maximum positive linear-sRGB component of the native calculated stellar surface; one divisor for all frames
spectral_color: CIE1931 XYZ from calculated optical harmonic lines; 683 applied once; fixed exposure to sRGB
tone_map: Positive in-gamut RGB / (1+maximumRGB); negative out-of-gamut channels clipped

surface.surface_assumption: Uniform normal-B atmosphere column; no surface temperature or field map
surface.geodesics: Direct outward Schwarzschild integrals with local SR Doppler and aberration
surface.phase_scope: Uniform surface has no temperature pattern; common GR-vs-flat outer propagation offset is not an aligned pulse prediction

spatial_camera.spatial_model: Uniform affine supports with node-calculated directional emissivity held constant within support

subpixel_geometry_aggregation.membership: Consecutive cells in one floor(cumulative_path/grid_m) bin; path steps are max(node movement, all eight ordered-corner movements)
subpixel_geometry_aggregation.representative: First existing reference cell in each bounded-path group; no synthetic geometry average
subpixel_geometry_aggregation.scope: Subpixel image support aggregation; source particle/radiation calculation unchanged
subpixel_geometry_aggregation.event_aggregation: Sum of each original directional XYZ power times physical number weight, at exactly the same source phase/time/interval
subpixel_geometry_aggregation.internal_weight_convention: Grouped power already contains the physical population; number_weights equals one

reference_geometry.membership: Consecutive cells in one floor(cumulative_path/grid_m) bin; path steps are max(node movement, all eight ordered-corner movements)
reference_geometry.representative: First existing reference cell in each bounded-path group; no synthetic geometry average
reference_geometry.scope: Subpixel image support aggregation; source particle/radiation calculation unchanged

spatial_camera.finite_support_retardation: Analytic source/arrival-window overlap integrated along each pixel subray in a frozen motion-quadrature piece
spatial_camera.piecewise_emissivity_error: Node radiation and affine geometry are unresolved approximations; no calibrated or converged image claim

multiresolution_camera.resampling: Integer-factor, cell-centred bilinear interpolation; grid_mode=True, nearest edge continuation
multiresolution_camera.surface_raster: Native output grid at the same physical camera scale
multiresolution_camera.limitation: Sub-plasma-pixel morphology is not resolved; interpolation changes raster sampling, not source radiation or display exposure

time_mapping: One physical rotation slowed to 8 seconds; constructed loop repeated 4 times

export.rate_control: quality-targeted VBR with a VBV cap; CRF is not a platform requirement
export.color_conversion: sRGB RGB to Rec.709 limited-range YCbCr via zscale; pixels transformed before tagging
export.conversion_reference: display-referred: sRGB EOTF to linear light, then inverse BT.1886 (gamma 2.4) for Rec.709 display encoding
export.instagram_processing: Instagram generates its own delivery encodings; playback quality is not guaranteed by local export
